summary: Five Surface tiles, one per material, over a brand to info to success gradient so the translucency is visible.
use: Comparing auto, solid, frosted, glass and liquid materials before picking one for a card or panel.
spec: `<Surface {material} elevation={3} p="4" class="tile">` rendered with `{#each materials as material (material)}`
Each tile prints its material name in a `.name` paragraph
